original_value: A sensitive dual-gas sensor for the detection of CH4 and C2H6 is demonstrated. Two tunable semiconductor lasers operating at 1.653 μm (for CH4 monitoring) and 1.684 μm (for C2H6) were used as the light source for spectroscopic measurements of CH4 and C2H6. Long-path absorption in a home-made compact dense-pattern multipass cell (Leff = 29.37 m) was employed, combined with wavelength modulation and second harmonic detection. Simultaneous detection of CH4 and C2H6 was achieved by separated wavelength modulations of the two lasers. Modulation frequencies and amplitudes were optimized for sensitivity detection of CH4 and C2H6 simultaneously. The dual-gas sensor exhibits 1σ detection limits of 1.5 ppbv for CH4 in 140 s averaging time and 100 ppbv for C2H6 in 200 s.

result.paraphrase: A sensitive dual-gas sensor for detecting CH4 and C2H6 is presented. Spectroscopic measurements of CH4 and C2H6 used two tunable semiconductor lasers as the light source, operating at 1.653 μm for CH4 monitoring and 1.684 μm for C2H6. The system combined long-path absorption in a homemade compact dense-pattern multipass cell with Leff = 29.37 m, wavelength modulation, and second-harmonic detection. Simultaneous CH4 and C2H6 detection was realized through separate wavelength modulation of the two lasers. Modulation frequencies and amplitudes were optimized to enable simultaneous sensitive detection of both gases. The dual-gas sensor achieves 1σ detection limits of 1.5 ppbv for CH4 at a 140 s averaging time and 100 ppbv for C2H6 at 200 s.
